prompt: Hand-painted Japanese emaki handscroll street of Edo about 1805, fine sumi ink lines and pale watercolour on warm paper, exactly matching the surrounding painting. Repaint only the cleared vertical strip so that the left and right halves join seamlessly: the front row of large grey kerb stones along the bottom edge continues at one even height straight across, and the middle row of smaller kerb stones either continues straight across or ends with a neat squared end stone; the earthen road between them stays level. Keep the same perspective, scale, colours, stone sizes and line weight as on both sides. No people, no animals, no text.
